01What does restaurant website development in Etah include?+

The scope can include mobile menu and restaurant experience, reservations, ordering and enquiry paths, maps, local discovery and analytics. We confirm the first useful release after reviewing the users, workflow and current tools.

02Can the website support reservations or online ordering?+

Yes. We can connect suitable booking, ordering or payment tools after confirming availability, fees, workflow and support responsibilities.

03Does WeTakeFWD have to be physically based in Etah?+

No. We can deliver remotely for organisations in Etah. Any on-site work, service area or local presence is described accurately and agreed before the project begins.
